statement: Write the ten decimal digits 0 through 9, one per line, in ascending order, and nothing else.
contract: Plain text. Exactly ten lines. No blank lines, no spaces, no trailing text.

test:
import sys
want = [str(i) for i in range(10)]
got = open(sys.argv[1]).read().split('\n')
got = [g for g in got if g != ''] if got and got[-1] == '' else got
bad = [i for i, (g, w) in enumerate(zip(got, want)) if g != w] + list(range(min(len(got), 10), 10)) + list(range(10, len(got)))
for i in bad:
    print(f'FAIL line {i + 1}: expected {want[i] if i < 10 else "nothing"}, got {got[i] if i < len(got) else "nothing"!r}')
print(f'{len(bad)} failing of 10')
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
